title: The Week of Nightmares
summary: The night the Ravnos clan was all but wiped out.

claims.text: Before the Week, the Ravnos of India were arguably the largest Kindred power in Asia, with princes ruling Indian cities and a long war against the Eastern Kindred.
The European Ravnos, who travelled with mortal Rroma families, were nearly annihilated, so outsiders and outcasts make up most of the European survivors.
Durga Syn still endures with a brood of neonates and ancillae.
Some whisper that whatever sealed Russia off from the supernatural also blunted the curse there.

title: Chimerstry After the Week
summary: Why illusions now turn on their makers.

claims.text: Chimerstry has worked differently ever since the Week of Nightmares; some Ravnos blame the founder's destruction, others a dying curse on the whole clan.
Using up the final point of temporary Willpower on an illusion leaves the Ravnos suffering as if struck by The Haunting from Dementation.

Pushing on past that point brings visions affecting every sense, at any hour and most often in tense moments, and they worsen until they become dangerous; a player who spots one can pay a Willpower point to dispel it.

title: Mayaparisatya
summary: Chimerstry at level nine, which alters what is real.

claims.text: This level nine power lets the Ravnos alter or create real objects or creatures for a limited time, such as turning the air around a rival to fire or making a locked door insubstantial.
It costs 10 blood points and a permanent Willpower point with Manipulation + Subterfuge, at difficulty 6 against objects or the victim's Willpower against characters.
It reaches anything within miles that the Ravnos is aware of; it is likely that no surviving Ravnos has mastered it since the Week.

title: Sympathetic Agony
summary: Chimerstry and Fortitude: an enemy feels the Ravnos's wounds.

claims.text: Created by the Kshatriya caste of India, it costs a blood point and a Manipulation + Intimidation roll against the victim's Perception + Self-Control.
Each success lets the Ravnos ignore the pain of one health level and pass it to the attacker, who suffers as if wounded; the Ravnos keeps the wounds and the power lasts a scene.

title: Mask of Cathay
summary: Animalism and Chimerstry: a Ravnos passes as one of the Eastern Kindred.

claims.text: Ravnos in Asia use it to hide among the Eastern Kindred by seeming to be one of them.
It costs a Willpower point and a blood point with Manipulation + Subterfuge at difficulty 6; each success is one an onlooker's sensing power must beat, or the Ravnos reads as a yin-aspected Kuei-jin.
It lasts one night per use and costs 15 experience points.

title: The Grave Robbers
summary: Five Ravnos hunting the clan's secrets in India.

claims.text: Linked loosely by shared interests before the Week, they drew together for protection afterwards, believing the end may already have begun.
Led by Dr. Lawrence Mayhew, an archaeologist and tomb robber, they took passage from an unknown benefactor to Calcutta and searched elder havens there and in other cities.
They found what they took for the Antediluvian's resting place, but it still rang with the battle and they left at once; they keep a manor outside Calcutta.
